text.p: SME - The government on Tuesday barred four journalists from its regular press conference for their hostile attitude to Prime Minister Vladimir Meciar.
- Slovakia has extended the broadcasting licence for Radio Free Europe until July, 1998.

NARODNA OBRODA - The state budget revenue from taxes totalled 102.8 billion crowns in the first nine months of the year, representing 70.9 percent of the planned sum for the whole year, and some 3.3 billion crowns more than in the same period last year.
HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - The government on Tuesday approved an agreement with Latvia on support and protection of investments.

- Production in the pharmaceutical industry totalled 4.89 billion crowns in the first eight months of this year, an increase of 6.3 percent over the same period last year. Industry sales totalled 4.8 billion crowns, some 5.3 percent more than in January-August period of 1995.

- Bratislava airport expects some one million passengers to use its services in the year 2000. The airport said it expected part of the passangers who at present use Vienna airport to fly from Bratislava in the future, as the Vienna airport will be focusing on more comfortable and more expensive services.
- At present, some 200,000 passengers use Bratislava airport, which has an annual capacity of 1.8 to 2.0 million passengers a year.
